About.journeySubtitle: A decade of growth, innovation, and excellence in kitchen engineering.

2014.title: Company Founded
2014.desc: PT. Limars Teknik Indonesia established in Jakarta, starting with stainless steel kitchen fabrication.

2016.title: Expanded Product Line
2016.desc: Added traditional stoves, regional ovens, and modern commercial oven manufacturing.

2018.title: Service Expansion
2018.desc: Launched ducting, gas installation, well drilling, and electrical services divisions.

2020.title: 300+ Projects Milestone
2020.desc: Completed over 300 projects across Indonesia, serving major hotel chains and restaurant groups.

2023.title: Modern Facility
2023.desc: Opened new manufacturing facility with advanced fabrication equipment and expanded capacity.

2026.title: Leading Manufacturer
2026.desc: Recognized as one of Indonesia's leading kitchen equipment manufacturers with nationwide coverage.
